mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expenses (expense_desc, amount, expense_date, category, is_trend_related) VALUES (#{expenseDesc}, #{amount}, #{expenseDate}, #{category}, #{isTrendRelated})
mapper.select: SELECT expense_id AS expenseId, expense_desc AS expenseDesc, amount, expense_date AS expenseDate, category, is_trend_related AS isTrendRelated, created_at AS createdAt FROM expenses ORDER BY expense_date DESC, expense_id DESC
